name: Town of Danville Volunteer Program
org: Town of Danville Recreation, Arts and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at town events and long projects, such as art gallery helper or theatre usher. You can do one event or stay longer.
who_can_apply: Volunteers 12 years and up. If a posting has its own age rule, it is listed in that posting. Volunteers under 18 need a parent or guardian to sign the Volunteer Agreement.
deadline_text: New chances are posted through the year. Each posting shows its own dates.
how_to_apply: Make a volunteer profile on the town website. Look at the open events and service projects. Sign up for one. For a long project, you send an interest form and town staff contact you.
notes: The Teens page says the town has volunteer chances for ages 13 and up. The volunteer page says 12 and up. Check each posting. Verification of community service hours is emailed by request after a volunteer event.
